rows.quote: Protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) from deCODE were obtained from the original 2021 publication for the data release [15].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E , Sulem P , Atlason BA , Sveinbjornsson G , Magnusson MI , Styrmisdottir EL , et al . Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease . Nat Genet . 2021 ; 53 ( 12 ): 1712 – 21 . doi: 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the deCODE pQTL were obtained from the original 2021 publication, citation 15, whose DOI is the source DOI of exactly one dictionary row; other passages give maximum N 35,559 and SomaScan v4.
